## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(bigrquery)
library(httr)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
```

```{r}

# ---- credentials and constants --------------------------------------------
apikey   <- "95A548D2-108A-39D9-AAFA-ABC87DFAE9FD"
states   <- state.abb           # "AL", "AK", …, "WY"
years    <- 2000:2020
base_get <- "https://quickstats.nass.usda.gov/api/get_counts/" # row-count endpoint
base_csv <- "https://quickstats.nass.usda.gov/api/api_GET/"    # CSV endpoint

```


```{r}
#apikey   <- "95A548D2-108A-39D9-AAFA-ABC87DFAE9FD"
states   <- state.abb
years    <- 2000:2020

UA       <- "corn-harvest-pull/0.2 (your_email@example.com)"
pause    <- 0.40      # seconds between *every* HTTP hit
tries    <- 5         # total RETRY() attempts

base_get <- "https://quickstats.nass.usda.gov/api/get_counts/"
base_csv <- "https://quickstats.nass.usda.gov/api/api_GET/"
```

```{r}
# ---- polite wrappers -------------------------------------------
polite_GET <- function(url, query) {
  resp <- RETRY("GET", url,
                query        = query,
                user_agent(UA),
                times        = tries,
                pause_base   = pause,
                pause_cap    = 6,
                pause_min    = pause,
                terminate_on = c(400, 404))
  Sys.sleep(pause)
  stop_for_status(resp)
  resp
}

polite_read_csv <- function(url) {
  resp <- RETRY("GET", url,
                user_agent(UA),
                times        = tries,
                pause_base   = pause,
                pause_cap    = 6,
                pause_min    = pause,
                terminate_on = c(400, 404))
  Sys.sleep(pause)
  stop_for_status(resp)

  read_csv(
    content(resp, "raw"),
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    col_types = cols(
      state_ansi  = col_character(),
      county_ansi = col_character(),
      .default    = col_guess()
    )
  )
}

# ---- one state-year pull, still fault-tolerant ------------------
pull_corn_area <- function(st, yr) {

  qry <- list(
    key               = apikey,
    commodity_desc    = "CORN",          # Focus on corn
    statisticcat_desc = "YIELD",         # Change from AREA HARVESTED to YIELD
    unit_desc         = "$ / ACRE",      # Yield in dollars per acre
    agg_level_desc    = "COUNTY",        # County-level data
    freq_desc         = "ANNUAL",        # Annual data
    state_alpha       = st,              # State abbreviation
    year              = yr,              # Year
    format            = "CSV"            # CSV format
  )

  cnt <- content(polite_GET(base_get, qry),
                 "parsed", simplifyVector = TRUE)$count
  if (cnt == 0) {
    message("  • No data for ", st, " ", yr, " (skipped)")
    return(NULL)
  }

  csv_url <- modify_url(base_csv, query = qry)

  out <- tryCatch(
    polite_read_csv(csv_url),
    error = function(e) {
      message("  • Failed to download ", st, " ", yr, " (skipped): ",
              conditionMessage(e))
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (is.null(out)) return(NULL)

  message("  • ", nrow(out), " rows added (", st, " ", yr, ")")
  out
}

# ---- main loop -------------------------------------------------
all_corn_county <- pmap(
  expand.grid(state = states, year = years, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  ~ pull_corn_area(..1, ..2)
) %>%
  # Remove NULL elements (failed downloads)
  compact() %>%
  # Convert all columns to character first to avoid type conflicts
  map(~ mutate(., across(everything(), as.character))) %>%
  # Bind all data frames together
  bind_rows() %>%
  # Convert columns back to appropriate types
  type_convert(col_types = cols(
    state_ansi = col_character(),
    county_ansi = col_character(),
    year = col_integer(),
    Value = col_double(),
    .default = col_guess()
  ))
```
